name: VibeSys container runtime
description: A static Docker engine (dockerd and the docker CLI), the compose plugin, kind, and kubectl, plus the `docker` group, for tasks whose candidate is a container topology. Debian/Ubuntu bases only.

docker_engine_version.description: Static Docker engine release; default mirrors vs_agent.provider_policy.DOCKER_ENGINE_VERSION.

docker_compose_version.description: Docker Compose plugin release; default mirrors vs_agent.provider_policy.DOCKER_COMPOSE_VERSION.

users.description: Space-separated existing users to add to the `docker` group, which owns the daemon socket. Empty adds none. Install fails if a named user does not exist.
